def LogSobolev.entropy.{u_1} : {X : Type u_1} → [inst : MeasurableSpace X] → MeasureTheory.Measure X → (X → ℝ) → ℝ :=
fun {X} [MeasurableSpace X] μ g =>
  ∫ (x : X), g x * Real.log (g x) ∂μ - (∫ (x : X), g x ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ (x : X), g x ∂μ)
def LogSobolev.localSlope.{u_1} : {X : Type u_1} → [MetricSpace X] → (X → ℝ) → X → ENNReal :=
fun {X} [MetricSpace X] f x => Filter.limsup (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal (dist (f y) (f x) / dist y x)) (nhds x)
def LogSobolev.slopeEnergy.{u_1} : {X : Type u_1} →
  [MetricSpace X] → [inst : MeasurableSpace X] → MeasureTheory.Measure X → (X → ℝ) → ENNReal :=
fun {X} [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] μ f => ∫⁻ (x : X), LogSobolev.localSlope f x ^ 2 ∂μ
def LogSobolev.MetricLSI.{u_1} : {X : Type u_1} →
  [MetricSpace X] → [inst : MeasurableSpace X] → MeasureTheory.Measure X → NNReal → Prop :=
fun {X} [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] μ C =>
  ∀ (f : X → ℝ),
    LocallyLipschitz f →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 2) μ →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => f x ^ 2 * Real.log (f x ^ 2)) μ →
          ENNReal.ofReal (LogSobolev.entropy μ fun x => f x ^ 2) ≤ 2 * ↑C * LogSobolev.slopeEnergy μ f

def LogSobolev.phaseMap : (N : ℕ) →
  WithLp 2 (ℝ × ↥(Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup (Fin N) ℂ)) → ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin N) ℂ) :=
fun N p => LogSobolev.phaseMul (√(2 / ↑N)) p.fst ⟨↑p.snd, ⋯⟩

def LogSobolev.specialUnitaryDeriv.{u_1, u_2} : {n : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Fintype n] →
    [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] →
      {F : Type u_2} →
        [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup F] →
          [NormedSpace ℝ F] →
            ↥LogSobolev.specialUnitaryLieAlgebra →
              (↥(Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup n ℂ) → F) → ↥(Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup n ℂ) → F :=
fun {n} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {F} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] A f U =>
  (mfderiv (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ ↥LogSobolev.specialUnitaryLieAlgebra) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ F) f U) A
def LogSobolev.specialUnitaryLocalRetraction.{u_1} : {n : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Fintype n] →
    [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] → ↥(Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup n ℂ) → Matrix n n ℂ → ↥(Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup n ℂ) :=
fun {n} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] U X =>
  U *
    LogSobolev.specialUnitaryExpCurve
      (LogSobolev.specialUnitaryAlgebraProjection (↑LogSobolev.specialUnitaryAmbientChart.symm (↑U⁻¹ * X))) 1

def LogSobolev.specialUnitaryLaplacian.{u_1, u_2} : {n : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Fintype n] →
    [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] →
      {ι : Type u_2} →
        [Fintype ι] →
          (ι → ↥LogSobolev.specialUnitaryLieAlgebra) →
            (↥(Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup n ℂ) → ℝ) → ↥(Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup n ℂ) → ℝ :=
fun {n} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {ι} [Fintype ι] b f U =>
  ∑ i, LogSobolev.specialUnitaryDeriv (b i) (LogSobolev.specialUnitaryDeriv (b i) f) U
def LogSobolev.specialUnitaryGamma.{u_1, u_2} : {n : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Fintype n] →
    [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] →
      {ι : Type u_2} →
        [Fintype ι] →
          (ι → ↥LogSobolev.specialUnitaryLieAlgebra) →
            (↥(Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup n ℂ) → ℝ) →
              (↥(Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup n ℂ) → ℝ) → ↥(Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup n ℂ) → ℝ :=
fun {n} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {ι} [Fintype ι] b f g U =>
  (LogSobolev.specialUnitaryLaplacian b (f * g) U - f U * LogSobolev.specialUnitaryLaplacian b g U -
      g U * LogSobolev.specialUnitaryLaplacian b f U) /
    2

  [inst : Fintype n] → [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] → n → ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) → Matrix n n ℂ :=
fun {n} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] i U => Matrix.diagonal fun j => if j = i then star (↑U).det else 1
def LogSobolev.unitaryToSpecialUnitary.{u_1} : {n : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Fintype n] → [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] → n → ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ) → ↥(Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup n ℂ) :=
fun {n} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] i U => ⟨LogSobolev.unitaryDetCorrection i U * ↑U, ⋯⟩

def LogSobolev.specialUnitaryGradient.{u_1, u_2} : {n : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Fintype n] →
    [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] →
      {ι : Type u_2} →
        [inst_2 : Fintype ι] →
          OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ ↥LogSobolev.specialUnitaryLieAlgebra →
            (↥(Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup n ℂ) → ℝ) →
              ↥(Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup n ℂ) → ↥LogSobolev.specialUnitaryLieAlgebra :=
fun {n} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {ι} [Fintype ι] b f U =>

def LogSobolev.powerKernel.{u_1} : {X : Type u_1} →
  [inst : MeasurableSpace X] → MeasureTheory.Measure X → (X → ℝ) → ℕ → X → ℝ :=
fun {X} [MeasurableSpace X] μ q j x => q x ^ j / ∫ (y : X), q y ^ j ∂μ
def LogSobolev.specialUnitaryPeak.{u_1} : {n : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Fintype n] → [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] → ↥(LogSobolev.specialUnitaryPolynomialSpace 1) :=
fun {n} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] =>
  ⟨LogSobolev.specialUnitaryAffineMap
      (↑(Fintype.card n) / (2 * ↑(Fintype.card n)),
        (2 * ↑(Fintype.card n))⁻¹ • Complex.reCLM.comp (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Matrix.traceLinearMap n ℝ ℂ))),
    ⋯⟩
def LogSobolev.specialUnitaryPowerKernel.{u_1} : {n : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Fintype n] → [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] → (j : ℕ) → ↥(LogSobolev.specialUnitaryPolynomialSpace j) :=
fun {n} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] j =>
  ⟨(∫ (U : ↥(Matrix.specialUnitaryGroup n ℂ)),
          ↑LogSobolev.specialUnitaryPeak U ^ j ∂LogSobolev.specialUnitaryHaar n)⁻¹ •
      ↑LogSobolev.specialUnitaryPeak ^ j,
    ⋯⟩
